_fixture_note: SYNTHETIC DEMO FIXTURE - a minimal STIX 2.1 bundle in the shape of MITRE ATT&CK enterprise-attack.json. Descriptions are short paraphrases written for this project, not ATT&CK text. Use `--mode live` to retrieve the real ATT&CK bundle.

objects.name: Network Service Discovery
objects.description: Adversaries enumerate services listening on remote hosts, for example with sequential connection attempts across ports.

objects.name: Brute Force: Password Guessing
objects.description: Adversaries repeatedly try candidate passwords against an account to gain access when credentials are unknown.

objects.name: Endpoint Denial of Service: Service Exhaustion Flood
objects.description: Adversaries send high volumes of requests to a service to exhaust its resources and degrade availability.
